summary: Implemented PDF highlight click selection, active range handles with drag-to-update persistence, 16-color MarginNote theming, and ZHIGHLIGHT_STYLE color import.
notes: PDF annotations now refresh when card data changes, so card color edits propagate to PDF highlights.
Handle dragging currently adjusts highlights whose start/end handles are on the same PDF page; multi-page highlights still render handles but cross-page drag adjustment is not attempted.

swift test and swift build were not executed in this ChatGPT Web runtime because the project depends on macOS AppKit/PDFKit; configured host validation should run them against the implementation commit.
